name: Greek Sheet Pan Chicken with Feta and Olives
ingredients_verbatim: 1 medium zucchini, cut into half moon slices
1/2 large red onion, cut into 1/4" wedges
unmapped: dried thyme (spice; board carries oregano/parsley/paprika but no thyme)
kalamata olives (board has black-olives and green-olives but no kalamata SKU)
why: Naturally low-carb Mediterranean sheet-pan chicken - chicken thighs roasted over non-starchy veg with no rice/potato/bread base. Published 437 cal / 11g carbs / 31g protein clears the band (above the 400 floor, far under the 35g carb ceiling) on the source card. Oven-only, weigh-and-divide, scales to 14. Adds cuisine spread the catalog is thin on. Most ingredients map to the board (Olive Oil, Lemon Juice, Garlic, Oregano, Paprika, Chicken Thighs, Zucchini, Bell Peppers, Onions, Tomatoes, Feta); dried thyme and kalamata olives flagged as possible board gaps for the pricer lane to rule on.
